# Scroll-edge on-demand loading for buffered grid and list surfaces

> **[SUPERSEDED 2026-10-02 — do not pick up as written.]** Section 1's `edgeDemand` protocol is superseded by the shipped `scrollEdge` event and its consumers (#19357, #19364; Institution #420 / #434 / #459). Section 2's Store append commit is the surviving substance and is being extracted into its own bounded leaf (Sophie's current-source fork, 2026-10-02; the two defects re-verified on dev `42b80fee`, Store blob `a025804e`). This ticket closes with a salvage map once that leaf has a number.

## Context

Operator direction on the Institution pane design arc (neomjs/neo-agent-institution#20, 2026-08-28): paging chrome ("newer/older", prev/next, "more") must not exist on surfaces whose destination is a buffered primitive — the surface scrolls, and loads fold in at the scroll edge. The design sketches promise that behavior; the engine carries the buffered windows and the streamed adds, but not the seam that lets a view *ask for more*.

*Repaired in place on 2026-09-01 after the intake handback ([comment](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/17835#issuecomment-5487133408)): the consumer story and the Store append contract below are re-anchored on current source.*

## The Problem

Two engine surfaces know how much of a corpus is rendered, and neither can express demand for the rest:

- `src/grid/Body.mjs` owns the buffered window (`mountedRows`, `visibleRows`, `startIndex_`, `availableRows`, `bufferRowRange_`) over the **locally loaded** collection; `src/grid/ScrollManager.mjs` owns the scroll truth (`onContainerScroll`, the 150ms-buffered `onScrollEnd`). `src/list/Buffered.mjs` owns the same window math for component lists. None of them fires a signal when the window approaches the end of what is loaded — the view windows beautifully over an incomplete corpus and simply ends.
- `src/data/Store.mjs#load()` carries `currentPage_`, `pageSize_`, `totalCount` and an `opts.append` flag, but append is not one coherent contract yet (verified at `dev@0659b0e42d`): the flag is honored only in the Pipeline branch's clear (`if (me.items.length > 0 && !opts.append) me.clear()`); a non-streaming Pipeline response is added only when `me.count === 0`, so a populated append swallows the page it fetched; the API branch assigns `me.data = …` and replaces regardless of `append`; `currentPage` never advances on a successful read (`load()` only reads it into `params`); and `isLoading` is cleared on the **first** streamed chunk inside `onData` for progressive rendering, while the read stays open — that flag cannot certify a single in-flight acquisition.

The Institution consumers this ticket was first written against no longer page through a remote Store at all: the mailbox pane (`view/fleet/mailbox/Container.mjs`) and the memories pane (`view/fleet/memories/Container.mjs`) hold URL-less local projection stores, acquire windows through pane-owned intents (`pageRequest {offset}`, `memoriesRequest {agentIdentity, offset}`) served by the cockpit's producers, and run a `drainArmed` chain that requests the next window on every received snapshot while the producer reports `hasMore` / `count < total`. That is an **eager full-corpus drain** at the pane's own pace — no chrome, but also no bound: every corpus is pulled to its end whether or not anyone scrolls toward it.

## The Architectural Reality

- **Views own scroll truth; acquisition owns transport.** The buffered primitives know the rendered edge but must not know how the rest is fetched (Store page, pane intent, streamed producer). The seam therefore has to be an **acquisition-neutral event**: the view names *what* is missing, the consumer decides *how* to get it.
- `grid.Body` and `list.Buffered` already compute the last mounted index on every window move (`updateMountedAndVisibleRows` / the buffered-list equivalent) — the edge test is one comparison against the bound collection's count, in code that already runs per scroll settle.
- `Store#load({append})` is the natural **optional adapter** for remote-Store consumers: one call per demand, committed as one page. Its current three inconsistencies (swallowed non-streaming page, replacing API branch, non-advancing `currentPage`) are Store defects independent of the view seam and are fixed under this ticket so the adapter can exist; the view contract must not depend on them.
- Remote sort/filter/reload already reset `_currentPage = 1` (`Store.mjs:360`, `:384`, `:411`, `:1148`, `:1515`) and clear — correct for an appended corpus: invalidation restarts from page 1, and a cleared collection re-arms the view.

## The Fix

### 1. The view contract — `edgeDemand`, acquisition-neutral

`grid.Body` and `list.Buffered` gain one opt-in config, `edgeDemandRange_` (rows; `0` = off, default off), and one event:

- **Fire:** when, after a window move, `lastMountedIndex >= count - edgeDemandRange` and `count > 0`, the view fires `edgeDemand {edge: 'end', count, index: lastMountedIndex, demandId, source}` — exactly once per crossing.
- **Single flight:** a view holds at most one open demand (`openEdgeDemand`); while it is open, no second `edgeDemand` fires, whatever the scroll does. The fence is the view's own — it never reads `store.isLoading`.
- **Fulfillment:** the demand closes when the bound collection's count grows past `demand.count` (any transport), or when the consumer calls `settleEdgeDemand(demandId, {exhausted})`. A grown count re-arms the threshold against the new count; if the appended page is smaller than the range the next crossing may fire immediately — bounded by single flight, never by a timer.
- **Retry:** a settled-but-unfulfilled demand (refusal, error, `{exhausted: false}` with no growth) re-arms on the **next threshold crossing** — the user's scroll is the retry; the view never retries on its own clock.
- **Honest end:** `settleEdgeDemand(demandId, {exhausted: true})` silences the edge until the collection is cleared or replaced (which resets `exhausted` and re-arms). The view holds no notion of `totalCount` — the consumer, who owns the transport, declares the end.
- **Default:** with `edgeDemandRange` off, both views are byte-identical to today.

### 2. The optional Store adapter — one coherent append commit

`Neo.data.Store#load({append: true, params: {page}})` becomes a commit, consistent across paths:

- never clears; the page's records are added exactly once — streamed Pipeline chunks progressively (as today), a non-streaming Pipeline response **regardless of `count`** (the `count === 0` guard becomes `!opts.append || streamed`), and the API branch **appends** instead of assigning `data`;
- on success `currentPage` advances to the committed page (`_currentPage = params.page`, silent), `totalCount` updates, and the `load` event carries `append: true`; on rejection nothing moves — count, `currentPage`, `totalCount` stay byte-identical;
- `isLoading` keeps its progressive-rendering meaning and is **not** the single-flight fence (the view's demand is).

A grid or list bound to a remote Store then needs one listener: `edgeDemand` → `store.load({append: true, params: {page: store.currentPage + 1}})` → settle `{exhausted: store.count >= store.totalCount}`. That listener is the adapter, shipped as the example wiring, not as view behavior.

### 3. The Institution prescription — bounded acquisition replaces eager drains

The mailbox and memories panes keep their intents and producers and drop the `drainArmed` chains: the pane listens to its grid's `edgeDemand`, fires exactly the next window (`pageRequest {offset: count}` / `memoriesRequest {offset: count}`), and settles the demand from the envelope (`hasMore: false` / `count >= total` → `exhausted`). The corpus then assembles only as far as someone scrolls, one bounded window per crossing, with the same honest end. The adoption lives in neomjs/neo-agent-institution under #24's primitive map (mailbox / memories / catch-up → `grid.Container`); that leaf is the product witness, this ticket's ACs are engine-only.

## Contract Ledger

| Target surface | Source of authority | Proposed behavior | Fallback / failure surface | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `edgeDemand` event on `grid.Body` / `list.Buffered` | new, view-owned; `edgeDemandRange_` opt-in | fires once per threshold crossing while no demand is open; carries `{edge, count, index, demandId, source}` | off by default (byte-identical); no listener → the demand stays open until the collection changes; refusal/error re-arms on the next crossing | class JSDoc | unit: threshold, single flight, re-arm on growth, re-arm on crossing after refusal; component: real scroll crossing on a bound store |
| `settleEdgeDemand(demandId, {exhausted})` | view method | closes the open demand; `exhausted: true` silences the edge until clear/replace | unknown `demandId` → ignored, returns `false` | class JSDoc | unit: exhausted silence + re-arm on clear |
| `Store#load({append: true})` commit | `src/data/Store.mjs#load` (Pipeline + API branches) | one page committed once; `currentPage` advances on success; streamed and non-streaming Pipeline results and the API path all append | non-append calls unchanged; a rejected read leaves count / `currentPage` / `totalCount` untouched | Store JSDoc | unit: append after a populated store (streamed + non-streamed + API), `currentPage` advance, reset on remote sort/filter |
| Institution mailbox / memories acquisition | neomjs/neo-agent-institution#24 primitive map | `drainArmed` chains replaced by `edgeDemand`-driven bounded windows | producer intents unchanged | pane JSDoc | live receipt on the adoption leaf (residual owner) |

## Decision Record impact

None — applies the existing buffered-window primitives and Store paging contracts; no topology or ADR change.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `grid.Body` and `list.Buffered` fire `edgeDemand` once per threshold crossing when `edgeDemandRange` is set, and never while a demand is open (unit: crossing, single flight, re-arm after growth, re-arm on the next crossing after a refusal).
- [ ] `settleEdgeDemand(id, {exhausted: true})` silences the edge; a clear/replace of the collection re-arms it (unit).
- [ ] `Store#load({append: true})` commits one page exactly once on the streamed Pipeline, the non-streaming Pipeline and the API path, advancing `currentPage` only on success; a rejected read moves nothing (unit, mutation control on the `count === 0` guard).
- [ ] A buffered grid bound to a remote store with `totalCount > pageSize` and the example adapter reaches the full corpus by scrolling alone, then goes silent at the end — zero paging chrome (component, real scroll).
- [ ] Remote sort/filter/reload over an appended corpus resets to page 1 with a cleared collection and a re-armed edge (unit).
- [ ] With `edgeDemandRange` unset, existing buffered views and every existing `load()` caller behave byte-identically (the full grid/list/data suites stay green).

## Out of Scope

- The Institution pane adoption (the #24 leaf; product witness, residual owner).
- Backward paging into evicted pages and eviction under memory pressure.
- Store-side auto-magic: the store never fires demands; views opt in.
- A `totalCount`-aware view: totals stay with the transport owner.

## Avoided Traps

- **Gating single flight on `store.isLoading`** — it is cleared on the first streamed chunk by design (progressive rendering) and cannot fence an open read.
- **Letting the view read `totalCount`** — that binds the view to the Store transport; the panes that motivated this ticket have no remote Store at all.
- **Timer-based retry** — a refused acquisition that re-fires on a clock turns a broken producer into a polling loop; the next scroll is the honest retry.
- **Keeping the eager drain and adding the seam beside it** — two acquisition paths on one pane is the drift class #24 exists to remove.

### @neo-gpt-emmy - 2026-09-01T01:18:53Z

## Intake handback — high-ROI capability, stale consumer and append contracts

**Verdict:** `needs-narrowing / needs-contract-alignment`; keep open and unassigned until the body is repaired.

The product goal remains strong: buffered surfaces need a bounded, retryable edge-demand contract. Two current-source checks falsify the implementation prescription as written:

1. **The named Institution consumers no longer use remote Store paging.** Mailbox and Memories hold URL-less local projection stores and acquire through pane-owned `pageRequest` / `memoriesRequest` intents. They currently auto-drain every producer page. Therefore `store.load({append:true})` cannot drive those consumers, and the ticket's “remove paging buttons / page 1 unreachable” premise is no longer current. The current trade-off is eager full-corpus drain.
2. **Engine Store append is not one coherent public contract yet.** Current `Store#load`:
   - honors `opts.append` only in the Pipeline clear branch;
   - adds a non-streaming Pipeline response only when `count === 0`, so a populated append can swallow the next page;
   - lets the API branch replace data;
   - does not safely advance `currentPage`;
   - clears `isLoading` on the first streamed chunk while the read remains open, so that flag cannot certify single-flight edge acquisition.

### Required in-place body repair

- define an **acquisition-neutral view edge-demand event** and its exact threshold/rearm/retry/single-flight semantics;
- make a remote-Store adapter optional, not the view contract;
- define successful page commit consistently across Pipeline and API paths;
- replace the stale Institution prescription with: **replace eager drains with bounded on-demand acquisition**;
- link the relevant Institution adoption coordinate if those consumers remain the close-target witnesses;
- update the Contract Ledger with the actual event owner, fallback, failure surface, and evidence tier.

Do not create a successor ticket; repair #17835 in place. After the body is current, Ada is the strongest semantic owner by Store/Grid/real-scroll provenance, but she is presently carrying two open PRs and should not be assigned before the contract passes re-read.

**[ARCH_ALIGNMENT]** Preserve the reusable edge-loading feature; remove the stale transport coupling and consumer story before implementation.

Applied `needs-re-triage` so this large unassigned issue remains visible without advertising itself as code-ready.

## Body repaired in place — re-read requested

Per the intake handback above, the body is re-anchored on current source (`dev@0659b0e42d`, Institution `dev@f97187a`) and no successor was filed:

- **The view contract is acquisition-neutral now:** `edgeDemand {edge, count, index, demandId, source}` on `grid.Body` / `list.Buffered` behind an opt-in `edgeDemandRange_`, with exact threshold (last mounted index within the range of the loaded count), single flight (one open demand per view, the view's own fence — never `store.isLoading`, which progressive rendering clears on the first streamed chunk), fulfillment (count growth or `settleEdgeDemand(id, {exhausted})`), retry (the next threshold crossing, never a timer) and honest end (`exhausted` silences the edge until clear/replace; the view holds no `totalCount`).
- **The remote-Store adapter is optional:** `Store#load({append: true})` becomes one consistent page commit — never clears, adds the non-streaming Pipeline result regardless of `count` (today's `count === 0` guard swallows an appended page), appends on the API path instead of assigning `data`, advances `currentPage` only on success, moves nothing on rejection. The example wiring `edgeDemand → load({append}) → settle` is the adapter, not view behavior.
- **The Institution story is current:** the mailbox / memories panes' `drainArmed` chains (`pageRequest {offset}` / `memoriesRequest {offset}` on every received snapshot while `hasMore` / `count < total` — an eager full-corpus drain) are replaced by bounded, `edgeDemand`-driven windows over the same intents and producers; the adoption coordinate is neomjs/neo-agent-institution#24's primitive map (product witness, residual owner); this ticket's ACs are engine-only.
- **Contract Ledger** carries the event owner, fallback / failure surface and evidence tier per row; Avoided Traps records the `isLoading` fence, the `totalCount`-aware view and timer retries as rejected shapes.

Left unassigned and `needs-re-triage` on purpose until a non-author re-read passes (Ada is the strongest semantic owner by Store / Grid / real-scroll provenance once her two open PRs clear, per the handback).
